articles.title: Arctic Winter Sea Ice Ties Record Low, NASA, NSIDC Scientists Find
articles.summary: For the second consecutive year, winter sea ice in the Arctic reached a level that matches the lowest peak observed since satellite monitoring began in 1979. articles.title: Live Coverage: SpaceX to launch batch of Starlink satellites from the West Coast
articles.summary: Liftoff of the Starlink 17-17 mission from Vandenberg Space Force Base, in California is scheduled during a launch window that opens at 4:03 p.m. PDT (7:03 p.m. EDT / 2303 UTC).
